sharingOwnerRules.description: All SFTS internal users (advocates, supervisors, admins) can read and edit each other''s Fundraising Events records. Required because event work is collaborative — board, staff, and volunteers all touch event records. External users (if any are added via Experience Cloud later) remain blocked by the Private OWD.
